text:
Megan L.: rolling a config-only tweak to routing + batching to dampen afternoon tail spikes. no model changes. change-id=cfg-2026-05-02-3. planned canary 6% for 60m. changes: routing.policy=even_spread->balanced_smooth, batch.window_ms=16->9, per_tenant_multiplier=1.0->0.92, request_timeout_ms=30000->31500. DeployBot: queued config-only deploy cfg-2026-05-02-3 (canary=6%, window=60m) — monitor: https://console.redwood/changes/cfg-2026-05-02-3
Srinivas: after ~10m seeing p95 +20% on a subset of canary hosts. batch p50 dropped 3->1.6. snippet: ```batching: p50=3->1.6; p95_latency_ms=200->240``` Ben: smaller window looks to reduce batching efficiency; cost delta later is a concern. Recommend pinning high-QPS tenants to previous config while we watch. Megan L.: agree. pin top tenants: tenant-main, tenant-proxy, tenant-search to cfg-prev. DeployBot: pins applied: tenant-main,tenant-proxy,tenant-search -> cfg-prev (action cfg-2026-05-02-pins)
Emily: attaching auto-rollback: errors>0.7% OR p95_delta>30% for 10m -> AUTO-ROLLBACK. DeployBot: rollback policy attached. OpsBot: created alert rule (escalate if errors>2x baseline or sustained p95_delta>40% for 15m) — https://ops.redwood/alerts/7412
Srinivas: post-pins the pinned tenants stable; remaining canary cohort p95 delta now ~12%, errors 0.04%. Recommend shrink canary to 2% and extend to 90m. Megan L.: reducing to 2%/90m and annotating release notes with exact keys and pin list. DeployBot: canary updated: 2%/90m by Megan L.; change doc updated: "routing=balanced_smooth; batch.window_ms 16->9; per_tenant_multiplier 1.0->0.92; request_timeout_ms 30000->31500; pinned tenant-main,tenant-proxy,tenant-search; rollback rules attached; canary 2%/90m"
Charlie: reminder: no unrelated routing/QoS config merges until final decision. Ben: please also add expected cost impact line to change doc (small ↑ per-token due to lower batching). Emily: runbook snippet for rollback in change doc: ```1) POST /deploy/rollback {"change_id":"cfg-2026-05-02-3"} 2) verify pins GET /config/pins 3) notify #eng-sre + #product 4) monitor key metrics 30m 5) open incident if errors>1% for 10m``` OpsBot: canary stable at 2% after 22m: p95_delta ~11%, errors 0.03%. next status update in 30m. Megan L.: thanks all — if anyone sees anomalies, call rollback immediately. :white_check_mark:
